title: Automated Quality Assurance, Invariant Testing & Adversarial Fuzzing
core_competencies: AABB spatial collision auditing: detecting room overlaps and corridor threshold pinch points.
WebSocket telemetry fuzzing: testing state packet serialization and packet drops.
Topological reachability tests: confirming all spawned zones have navigable doorways.
Regression post-mortems: converting bugs into permanent prevention rules.
anti_patterns: Rubber-stamping milestone reviews without testing on-disk artifacts.
Allowing unverified deliverables to count toward burndown.
